Messages.Author: Patrick van der Reest
Messages.Body:
Hello!

At our regular wednesday night game, I happened on a peculiar situation. I
was in dire straits and would not survive (being bled at stealth, and having
little to no pool gain), but I had 3 pool and a Life Boon in hand. The game
was down to three players, with my prey (and grand-predator) bleeding my
predator. He threatened to bleed him out, and would have swept through me
most likely. I played Life Boon on him for the three pool I had, which saved
him for the turn. Now, by that I ousted myself and gave a victory point to
my predator (because his prey was ousted). Do I receive that, due to the
Life Boon? Our prince thought not but was not sure (which is highly unusual
for Jay, who has yet to be wrong on a ruling in my presence), so I'd thought
to ask.

Blessings,

Patrick
Columbus, OH

> most likely. I played Life Boon on him for the three pool I had, which saved
> him for the turn. Now, by that I ousted myself and gave a victory point to
> my predator (because his prey was ousted). Do I receive that, due to the
> Life Boon?

No.
Current Sabbat War card text for Life Boon:

Life Boon [Jyhad, V:TES, SW]
Cardtype: Master
Master: out-of-turn.
Give pool to a Methuselah with no pool to keep <him or> her
in the game; put this card in play. During each of his or her
untap phases, you can collect 1 pool from that Methuselah.
The first victory point (and ante) that the Methuselah wins
is given to you (unless you are ousted by then). This Life
Boon is then burned.

Notice the important change:

"(unless you are ousted by then)"

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

I'm still not sure about this. It seems related to Josh's question about
"spending pool" and effects of a card all resolving at the same

VP turns after you were no longer in the game. But if you are ousted by

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"David Cherryholmes" asked:

> > Current Sabbat War card text for Life Boon:

> > Notice the important change:
> > "(unless you are ousted by then)"

> I'm still not sure about this. It seems related to Josh's question about
> "spending pool" and effects of a card all resolving at the same
> time. Clearly it doesn't work the way it used to, where you could gain a
> VP turns after you were no longer in the game. But if you are ousted by
> the effects of playing the card, then wouldn't you still be in the game
> for all the other effects of that card?

No.
If you are ousted, you are ousted.
You cannot get any benefit from Life Boon if you are ousted.

This is exactly the reason the card text was changed, to prevent people
from stealing the VP for their own death.

From the May 1st, 2000 Rules Team Rulings:

http://www.thelasombra.com/rules/RTR5-100.htm

Life Boon doesn't provide a VP if you are ousted.
Since (as a master card) it is burned when you are ousted, this
makes some sense, but it is still errata to change the "even if
you are ousted by then" to "unless you are ousted by then".
Note: this means that you cannot get a VP for your own ousting -
you will be ousted (and Life Boon's effect will terminate)
before you can collect.
